title: He Dived 332 m. Getting Back Took Nearly 15 Hours

lines.text: Going down took him twelve minutes.
Coming back up took nearly fifteen hours.
Dahab, Egypt, 2014. Ahmed Gabr drops into the Red Sea.
No submarine. Just scuba tanks and a rope.
One hundred metres. Two hundred. Three hundred.
Tags on the rope will prove the depth.
Deeper than the Eiffel Tower is tall.
A new world record. The old mark had stood since 2005.
Now the hard part: getting back.
Rise too fast, and gas in his body forms bubbles. The bends.
So he climbs slowly, stop after stop, through dozens of gas tanks.
Nearly fifteen hours after he left, he breaks the surface.
Six years later, anonymous critics claimed the evidence didn't add up.
Its conclusion: he did reach three hundred and thirty-two metres.
Twelve minutes to set it. Nearly fifteen hours to survive it.

shots.description: Frame 1 is already mid-descent: a vertical white rope (guideline, straight down) runs through the centre of a deep blue water column. The diver slides down it head-first, fast, bubbles streaming upward past camera. Light above is bright turquoise, below is black. A 'DOWN' clock races in the upper third.
shots.camera: Camera falls with the diver (parented, slight lag), looking down the rope into darkness, 24 mm, diver in middle third; motion from frame 1
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)
shots.lighting: Sun shafts (god_rays) from above fading with depth; world_volume blue (0.05,0.35,0.55) density 0.03

shots.description: Hard reversal: the same rope, now seen from below looking UP toward a tiny bright surface far above. The diver hangs motionless on the line, a small dark shape against the light. An 'UP' counter ticks in red, then freezes on a text card.
shots.camera: Static low angle looking straight up the rope, 20 mm; very slow push-in
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)
shots.lighting: Distant surface glow only; diver in silhouette

shots.description: Map card: Sinai peninsula / Gulf of Aqaba outline, route line from 'RED SEA' to a pin at Dahab on the east Sinai coast. Then cut-in: sunlit coast — low desert hills (ground builder, sand colour), a dive_boat moored off a fringing reef, diver rolling backward off the side.
shots.camera: 2D map push (first 1.6 s) then 35 mm wide over the water, slight handheld
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)
shots.lighting: Hard desert sun (sun lamp, warm 5500K), sky_gradient clear blue

shots.description: Kit reveal: the diver turns slowly on the rope, showing the tanks clipped all over the harness. A ghosted outline of a submarine slides in behind and gets a red strike-through (2.5D line art), leaving only the diver and the rope.
shots.camera: Orbit 90 deg around the diver, 35 mm, mid-shot
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)
shots.lighting: Blue daylight, soft caustics on the tanks

shots.description: Depth ladder: side view of the rope as a vertical ruler; floating depth plates (text3d '100 m', '200 m', '300 m') whip past as the diver drops. Colour drains: blue → indigo → black. A few fish at 100 m, nothing at 300 m.
shots.camera: Side-on tracking down the rope, 28 mm, camera speed eases between plates; each plate passes on its spoken word
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)
shots.lighting: Ambient fades from blue to near-black; only the diver's dim torch remains by 300 m

shots.description: Close on the rope in torchlight: small white tags zip-tied at intervals, each with a printed depth number. The diver's glove slides past them.
shots.camera: Macro-ish 50 mm, rope diagonal across frame, slow drift down
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins) (glove only)
shots.lighting: Single helmet torch, cool white, hard shadows on the rope

shots.description: Bottom of the dive (no seabed — open black water): the glove unclips a tag from the rope. Depth gauge snaps to 332.
shots.camera: Close 50 mm, snap zoom on the tag, slight shake on the gauge stop
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)

shots.environment: other:scale comparison — dark water column with ghost Eiffel Tower
shots.description: The tiny diver at the bottom of the rope; beside the rope a translucent low-poly lattice tower (new prop: 4 tapered box-frame legs, 3 platforms, spire; emissive wireframe, 330 m to scale) rises from the diver's depth to the surface line. The tower is shorter than the rope.
shots.camera: Fast pull-back / crane up from the diver to the surface, 35 mm, ending wide with whole water column in frame
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins) (tiny)
shots.lighting: Wireframe glow teal; surface line bright

shots.description: Generic record card (no Guinness logo) slides up over black water: two bars — '2005: 318.25 m' (grey) and '2014: 332.35 m' (yellow, grows past it).
Back at 332 m: the diver looks up the rope; the surface is an invisible pinprick. Camera tilts up the endless rope into black.
shots.camera: Tilt up 70 deg along the rope, 24 mm
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)

shots.description: X-ray silhouette of a diver (generic, faceless). Tiny dissolved-gas dots fill the body; a fast upward arrow makes the dots swell into bubbles; red X stamps over the arrow on 'The bends'.
shots.camera: Static, 50 mm, quick shake on the X

shots.description: Decompression in shallower blue water: the diver hangs still on the rope; spent tanks are clipped off and float up out of frame while fresh stage tanks descend on a line beside him. Stop markers (text3d) step up the rope.
shots.camera: Slow crane up the rope, 28 mm; time-lapse feel (light cycles brighter)
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins)
support_diver x2 (stylised, single tank, red fins; background only)
shots.lighting: Blue light brightening as depth decreases; later shots warm toward sunset

shots.description: Night surface off Dahab: the diver's head and torch break the surface beside the moored dive_boat, deck lights on. Calm swell.
shots.camera: Low at the water line, 35 mm, slow push
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins) (head and torch only)
shots.lighting: Night: deck floodlights warm, moonlight cool rim; dark sky

shots.description: Pattern break: black screen, a stack of anonymous emails/documents slides in (no names, text redacted bars). Orange DISPUTED label.

overlay.text:
CLAIM: THE EVIDENCE
DOESN'T ADD UP

shots.description: Same desk: a magnifier (simple prop) slides over the tag, the depth log and the rope diagram one after another.
shots.camera: 2D, magnifier tracks across three items, 1 s each

shots.description: Generic review card stamps down: 'REVIEW CONCLUDED — 332.35 m CONFIRMED'. DISPUTED label swaps to DOCUMENTED.
Return to the deep rope at 332 m: the last tag glints in the torch beam, then the torch clicks off — a beat of black water with the yellow 332 m text holding.
shots.camera: Static 50 mm on the tag, slow drift
characters: gabr_diver (stylised faceless char_diver: black wetsuit + hood, sidemount twin tanks, 4 stage cylinders clipped each side, yellow fins) (glove only)
